title: Baker Hill Road Distict (Baker Hill Road District)

communications.communication:
To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the Freedom of Information Act, I hereby request the following records:

VIA EMAIL
TO:Lorna Gayle, Clerk / Records Access Officer (bakerhillroaddistrict@gmail.com)
Baker Hill Road District
CC:Ruth Knysh, Town Clerk (rknysh@lanesborough-ma.gov)   
Town of Lanesborough, MA
RE: Public Records Request (M.G.L. c. 66) — Targeted Financial & Compensation Summaries

Dear Ms. Gayle,

Pursuant to the Massachusetts Public Records Law (M.G.L. c. 66, § 10), I hereby request electronic copies of the following public records generated, held, or maintained by the Baker Hill Road District:
Compensation & Stipend Summaries:Annual summary reports, W-2/1099 ledgers, or payroll exports detailing all stipends, compensation, fees, or expense reimbursements paid to Prudential Committee members (Bill Prendergast, John Goerlach, Hank Sayers), officers, administrative staff, and legal counsel for the past three fiscal years.   

Three-Year Financial Statements & Balance Detail:Annual accounting summaries, balance sheets, profit & loss statements, and check registers showing itemized receipts and disbursements for the past three fiscal years.

Current Balances, Receivables & Outstanding Liabilities:The most recent monthly bank/reserve account statements showing current cash balances.A current accounting schedule of all receivables (including delinquent property assessments and back taxes associated with the Berkshire Mall / JMJ RE Holdings property).

An itemized statement or summary schedule of all current debts, liabilities, and unpaid service contract obligations owed to external entities or the Town of Lanesborough.

To ensure this request remains efficient and cost-effective, please provide these records in existing electronic format (e.g., PDF, Excel, or accounting software exports) via email.Pursuant to M.G.L. c. 66, § 10, I look forward to your response within ten (10) business days.

 If the total search or compilation fee is estimated to exceed $25.00, please notify me in writing with an itemized breakdown before fulfilling the request.

Thank you for your assistance.

Sincerely,
Lanesborough Resident

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 20 business days, as the statute requires.

Sincerely,

seal goals
